description: The behaviour clock for one ranked agent: run_days (complete UTC days since the last break in its own payment behaviour, by a CUSUM on payments, USD, payees and new-payee share against its own history), the last break's date and feature, and its heartbeat over 30 days (scheduled, irregular, bursty or sparse, with the dispersion index and the gap CV). A break is a change, not a harm; the measured false-break rate is published in the document. Definitions stability.run_length.v1 and stability.heartbeat.v1.

agent.description: Agent token id, slug or bound wallet

name: agent_stability
title: How long an agent has behaved the same way (free)
